name: PMMSY: Motorcycle with Ice Box - Gujarat
benefit:
1. The unit cost of a motorcycle with an ice box is ₹75,000/-.
1. General category beneficiaries receive 40% assistance, i.e., up to ₹30,000/-.
1. Women and Scheduled Tribe (ST)/Scheduled Caste (SC) beneficiaries receive 60% assistance, i.e., up to ₹45,000/-.
1. Assistance is provided once in a lifetime.
1. The benefit is available as per the target (category) allocated by the Government of India.
_eligibility_text: 1. The applicant should be a native of Gujarat state. 1. The applicant should have a fishing boat registered under Real Craft software. 1. The applicant should hold a fishing license. 1. The applicant should complete the online registration on the [iKhedut Portal](https://ikhedut.gujarat.gov.in/site/).1. The applicant should obtain in-principle approval before purchase of the floor plan. 1. The applicant should have his/her own bank account. > **Preference/Reservation/Relaxation:** - Women, SC, and ST beneficiaries are eligible for 60% assistance of the unit cost. - General category beneficiaries are eligible for 40% assistance of the unit cost.
